output.summary: A herbaceous biennial, rarely perennial, native in its wild forms to parts of Europe, North Africa, Macaronesia and Western Asia. Cultivated groups include sugar beet, beetroot and chard, with fleshy roots or edible leaves and midribs; roots may be red, white or yellow.
output.edibilityNote: Cultivated forms provide table sugar, beetroot, and edible chard or spinach-beet leaves and midribs, eaten cooked in several ways.
